paid_market_gaps.gap: Full FDA compliance platforms start at $35k per product line; little in between for small device makers
Cheap CRA tools target SaaS repos, not firmware/hardware makers needing binary SBOMs and RED/PSTI coverage
FDA-focused platforms lack EU MDR/CRA coverage; multi-regulation tracking per product still in development
SMEs cite cost, time and resources as main CRA barriers and ask for financial support

wtp_evidence: Regulation-forced spend: Medcrypt lists $35k per product line/year, typical first-year $50-60k; many firms still expect not to be fully CRA-compliant by the 2027 deadline.
bundling_note: SBOM export is free in GitHub and Amazon Inspector and AppSec suites add CRA modules, but risk assessment, disclosure and regulator reporting workflows are not bundled.
summary: Crowded at enterprise (Cybellum, Finite State, ONEKEY, Medcrypt) and among cheap SaaS-focused CRA tools; opening is affordable multi-regulation (CRA/RED/PSTI/FDA) compliance for small hardware and firmware makers.
